card.line: Seneh was a sharp cliff on one side of a pass near Michmash, where Jonathan set out to face a Philistine outpost trusting the LORD.

moments.title: Cliffs beside the pass
moments.text: Jonathan planned to cross a pass to reach the Philistine outpost. Cliffs stood on both sides, one named Bozez and the other Seneh. Seneh was the southern one, facing Geba.

moments.title: Jonathan trusts the LORD
moments.text: Jonathan told his armor-bearer they would cross to the outpost, saying nothing can hinder the LORD from saving by many or by few. The armor-bearer said he was with him heart and soul.
